arStrings.szText: When hit while not {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c}, you form a protective bubble that grants all Players inside {c_important}{u}Immune{/u}{/c}. The bubble lasts for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds and can only form once every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds.
Being hit while not {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c} forms a bubble that grants {c_important}{u}Immune{/u}{/c} for {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|1|]{/c} seconds.
